en: Fixed the Claude apps gateway not checking every model a request names against `availableModels`, `deniedModels` and `models`; a request that names a blocked model now gets a 400 naming the field
zh: 修复 Claude 应用网关未按 `availableModels`、`deniedModels` 和 `models` 检查请求中指定的每个模型的问题；现在指定了被阻止模型的请求会收到 400 并指明对应字段
